headline: Open tools for AlphaFold confidence scoring, RNA structure comparison and MD clustering
label: Structural Bioinformatics Software Tools
summary: Recent open-source tools automate confidence scoring, secondary structure comparison, trajectory clustering and complex evaluation for structural models.
synthesis: The four items share a focus on making established structural analyses easier to run, combine and inspect. VMDance brings MDANCE clustering methods and PRIME representative selection into the VMD environment for molecular dynamics trajectories. RNAcomp2D runs multiple RNA secondary structure predictors, including thermodynamic and deep learning models, in one web interface and visualizes their predictions side by side. ReactifpTM reimplements the actifpTM interface confidence score as a standalone Python tool that takes PAE and model outputs from AlphaFold 2 and 3. pdb_cpp provides a C++ library with Python bindings for PDB parsing, interface analysis, SASA, and DockQ and TM-score evaluation. What is new is the packaging of these methods as open, scriptable components. The summaries do not report benchmarks against alternative implementations.
